text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while passing by the academy garden, I notice Yukino Bijin harvesting vegetables with the groundskeeping committee.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey! I finally finished pack'n all the veggies.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yukino! I stacked up all the boxes of carrots over there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks. Can you do the komatsuna spinach now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Tracen Academy, managing the flower beds and vegetable garden is mostly left to the groundskeeping committee. And as far as I know, Yukino Bijin isn't a member.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer. What's got you look'n so puzzled over there?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that all? I just like help'n out wherever I can!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I used t'help out in the fields back home, so I thought I might be of use here too.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And we're grateful for it! Ever since Yukino Bijin started lending a hand, we've gotten the insects and other critters under control, and our veggies are tasting better than ever!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: We hope we can continue to rely on your help in the future as well!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So long as you'll have me! 'Sides, digg'n holes helps me relax. I should be the one thank'n you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't forget about me! As someone bestowed with the title of class rep, I'll do whatever I can to help out my friends on the groundskeeping committee!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oooh, thank you! The more the merrier!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! Time to unleash my super-duper class rep speed and harvest some veggies!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Golly! She's faster than a speed'n bullet! Ah, but veggies can be delicate, so be careful not to damage them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll Bakushin nice and gentle-like!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Grab them here, where you don't eat. Yep, that's it! Then pull 'em out like so…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yep! Right as rain! ♪

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Such bounty! But I must say, squatting like this all day leaves you quite stiff…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's why you should get up and stretch at reg'lar intervals! Want me t'teach you a stretch I learned from this farmer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Take your hand towel and hold it with both hands, like this. Then chant, "Morioka! ♪ Fertile and loamy! Give me veggies for my home-y! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Extraordinary! Give us veggies for our home-y! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew… Great work, ev'ryone.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Look at everything we harvested today! I'm sure carrots straight from the garden taste extra scrumptious!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Would it be okay t'cook some of these up? There's noth'n like the smell of soup made from fresh veggies!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A warm bowl of that's enough t'keep me warm even dur'n a blizzard! And it makes shovel'n snow easy as pie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone's eyes sparkle as they listen to Yukino Bijin talk excitedly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Trainer? Earth to Trainer. Are you there?
choice_data_list: People from colder climates sure have a lot of vitality.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Trainer? Earth to Trainer. Are you there?
choice_data_list: People from colder climates sure have a lot of vitality.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-teacher? Me?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think you're really good at leading others.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: N-no way! I'm just used to this kinda thing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You don't have to be so modest! You had the sparkle of a class rep when you were giving out instructions!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, golly, aw, geez… C'mon, you're embarrass'n me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But… I'm glad y'think so highly of me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin may be blushing as red as a tomato, but I can also see pride shining in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I've been shovel'n snow and harvest'n crops since I was a kid. I've gotten so used to it that it's actually fun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But… you don't think I looked weird, do you?
choice_data_list: You looked like you were having fun.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hah! That's 'cause I was. I love farm'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pour'n your heart into nurtur'n your veggies and then hear'n everyone say how delicious they are when they're ready to eat…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's the kinda thing that warms m'heart. I've felt this way since I was a kid.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I agree! I may be new to all this, but the excellence Yukino's talking about has got my heart racing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Hehe, I'm pleased as punch t'hear it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching Yukino Bijin's eyes sparkle as she speaks, my heart is put at greater ease.
